cell_case_summary_method: attribution context, unsupported_q_obs; in E/E_scope improved, where Q_obs = T is correct (`correct_here` true), the cell instead carries correct_acceptance (`metric` says which) and no zero-event bound. equal_case_mean = mean over cases of the case's mean over scored repeats; ci95_case_t = t interval over case means (df = cases - 1), clipped to [0, 1], descriptive and anti-conservative near 0/1; degenerate = every case has the same mean (zero width is not precision). zero_event_upper_case = exact one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson bound over cases, 1 - 0.05**(1/cases), given only when no case has an event (null otherwise); it treats cases as exchangeable draws from the builder's case population. scheduled / cases_scheduled from manifest.json.

zero_event_bounds.label: Per cell, unsupported Q_obs.
